Game Overview

In Elemental Domination, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner alchemist in Elemental Domination. Merge fire, water, earth, and air blocks across 145 captivating puzzles. Strategize your moves and transform elements to bring harmony to a mystical world. With increasing challenges, every level tests your wit and precision in this enchanting realm of elemental magic.
